text: Action: Play with play-dough to develop the look and feel of the design and the user interface.
Decision: Do not include the D_V_D_ feature.
Decision: Adopt a minimal wheel-based remote with limited buttons, smaller than previously shown remotes.
Decision: Menu accessible on the TV screen (T_V_) rather than on the remote, and constrained to be inside the TV (T_V_).
Decision: Use batteries as the energy source and propose developing two prototypes to compare options and gather user feedback.
